title: Player Only Mob Loot
description: Mob loot only drops if a player participated in the kill or specific vanilla exceptions occur.
body:
Player Only Mob Loot changes how mob drops work.

Mob loot will only drop if a player was involved in damaging the mob, or if the kill comes from specific vanilla mechanics.

Allowed cases:
- player damages a mob and it later dies from fall damage, fire, etc.
- a tamed wolf kills a mob
- a skeleton kills a creeper
- a charged creeper produces a mob head

All other deaths (environmental damage, mob vs mob fights, automated farms) will not produce loot, equipment drops, or experience.
